content: Claire House Children's Hospice is a specialized facility in England that provides care for children up to the age of 18 who are living with life-threatening or life-limiting medical conditions. The hospice offers a range of services, including expert respite care, palliative care, end-of-life care, and bereavement support for families. Its primary mission is to improve the quality of life for its young patients and their families. Located in Bebington on the Wirral, the hospice operates largely through charitable donations and requires approximately £2 million annually to maintain its operations. The facility has garnered support from numerous celebrities, with one of the most prominent being Wayne Rooney and his partner, Coleen McLoughlin. Coleen has a personal connection to the hospice, as her sister is one of its beneficiaries. She has also appeared on Trevor McDonald’s program to raise awareness about the challenges faced by children's hospices. Recently, Claire House has expanded its services by opening a new Teenage Annex.
